title: Naturality of block projections of active concatenation
statement: Use quasicategories, coherent functors, transformations and mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], symmetric infinity-operads, their inert edges and active and inert pointed maps of [lem-coef-operadic-approximation-restriction], and the active concatenation $\oplus$ of [lem-coef-active-operad-cocartesian-concatenation]. Let $\mathcal C^\otimes\to N(\mathrm{Fin}_*)$ be a symmetric infinity-operad, let $s\geq0$, and let $F:(\mathcal C^\otimes_{\mathrm{act}})^s\to\mathcal C^\otimes_{\mathrm{act}}$ be the $s$-fold ordered concatenation $\mathbf x=(x_1,\ldots,x_s)\mapsto\bigoplus_{j=1}^sx_j$, the empty tuple when $s=0$. Write $\iota:\mathcal C^\otimes_{\mathrm{act}}\to\mathcal C^\otimes$ for the inclusion and $\mathrm{pr}_j$ for the $j$th projection of the product. If $x_j$ lies over $\langle r_j\rangle$ and $r=\sum_jr_j$, then $F(\mathbf x)$ lies over $\langle r\rangle$, and for an active tuple $\mathbf h=(h_j:x_j\to x_j')$ with pointed maps $\gamma_j$ the arrow $F(\mathbf h)$ lies over the blockwise sum $\coprod_j\gamma_j$, which sends the $j$th consecutive input block into the $j$th output block. For each $j$ there is a coherent transformation $p_j:\iota F\Rightarrow\iota\,\mathrm{pr}_j$ of functors $(\mathcal C^\otimes_{\mathrm{act}})^s\to\mathcal C^\otimes$, unique up to a contractible space of choices, whose component $p_j(\mathbf x):F(\mathbf x)\to x_j$ is an inert edge over the block projection $q_j:\langle r\rangle\to\langle r_j\rangle$ (the identity of the $j$th block onto $\langle r_j\rangle$, every other input to the basepoint). In particular, for every active tuple $\mathbf h:\mathbf x\to\mathbf x'$ there are coherent squares $p_j(\mathbf x')\,F(\mathbf h)\simeq h_j\,p_j(\mathbf x)$, with all higher simplices of these naturality data. Empty blocks $r_j=0$ are included; for $s=1$ the transformation $p_1$ is an equivalence $F\simeq\mathrm{id}$, and for $s=0$ there are no projections.
